About

Creativity, design and technology, together.

Parnia is a graphic designer and Computer Engineering student working at the intersection of visual design and artificial intelligence. Her design practice centers on brand identity, logo design, and visual communication for freelance and institutional clients, built on strong foundations in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.

Alongside her design work, she is developing technical skills in AI, machine learning and data science — from Python-based data workflows to FastAPI backends — and has applied them in interdisciplinary projects spanning landscape architecture, urban intelligence, and content platforms.

She believes design should be both visually considered and genuinely purposeful, and is drawn to work that blends creative and technical thinking.
